checks.coverage: 8192 state/input combinations, including every legal one-hot state and all eight input combinations; table-based transition and Moore-output oracle

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
Extra zero-hot and multi-hot tests verify the direct one-hot equation interpretation; the specified FSM assumes one-hot states.

Unknown-valued inputs are not specified and were not included in the exhaustive binary stimulus.
